project_name: Southwest Intertie Project North (Midpoint-Robinson Summit 500 kV)
sponsor: Great Basin Transmission (LS Power) / Idaho Power
instrument: CAISO Board Addendum 1 to the 2022-2023 Transmission Plan (conditional approval, ISO assumes GBT entitlements; ISO funds 77.2%), 2023-12-14; IPUC CPCN Dec 2025; PUCN UEPA permit; DOE TFP up to $331M (2024-04)
mapping_note: 285-mi 500 kV Midpoint (ID) -> Robinson Summit (NV); with ON Line + DesertLink the ISO gains a contiguous controlled corridor Idaho->Eldorado with a board-stated N->S 1,117.5 MW ISO entitlement (S->N 1,072.5 incl. 500 MW Idaho Power). Applied as an uplift to the WECC_import_simultaneous cap (fitted 7,500 MW default, audit C-5 fallback) — new controlled deliverability that does NOT overlap the COI/WOR corridors the 7,500 envelopes. Tension documented: CAISO's advisory RA MIC holds new branch groups at 0 MW until import history exists, so the published MIC series shows no uplift; the entitlement is nonetheless a board-approved deliverability acquisition (methodology sec 6).
source_doc: CAISO Board SWIP-North decision presentation Dec 2023
notes: Construction start 2026-04, completion mid-2028 (Idaho Power 2026-03; slipped from end-2027).

project_name: Gates - Los Banos No. 3 500 kV series compensation (Path 15)
instrument: CAISO Board approval of the 2025-2026 Transmission Plan (economic project 2026-E-01, $150M), 2026-05-19
mapping_note: Adds 70% series compensation to the WAPA Los Banos-Gates No. 3 500 kV line 'to address congestion on Path 15' (model link NP15-ZP26, static 5,400 MW). CAISO published need/benefit language only — no MW transfer-capability increase — so the delta is recorded 0.0 (rule 5); re-rate when a WECC path re-rating or CAISO posting quantifies it.
notes: COD unpublished; in_service_year 2029 is a labeled placeholder (typical series-comp lead time) — inert at 0.0 delta.

project_name: Imperial Valley - North of SONGS 500 kV + substation
instrument: CAISO Board approval of the 2022-2023 Transmission Plan ($2,288M), 2023-05-18; sponsor selected 2024-04-29 (Horizon West); line portion assigned to SDG&E 2025-08-29
mapping_note: 135-mi series-compensated 500 kV Imperial Valley -> new North of SONGS 500/230 substation — a new 500 kV source north of San Diego that bypasses the existing Path 44 boundary the one-way SP15_rest->SDGE link (LCT import cap 1,436 MW static) represents. Line thermal ~3,290 MVA is not an import-cap rating and CAISO publishes no LCR/import-capability delta — recorded 0.0 (rule 5); post-2032 the SDGE pocket boundary needs an LCT-based re-rate (methodology sec 6).
source_doc: HWT WECC 2025 Annual Progress Report (COD Oct 2032); CAISO 2022-23 plan exec summary
notes: Companion North of SONGS - Serrano 500 kV (SCE+Lotus, $503M, ~2032-33) similarly reworks the SP15_rest->LA_BASIN seam; carried in this row's notes pending its own published COD.

instrument: Merchant line (BLM ROW + AZ/NM siting; capacity fully subscribed by SunZia Wind); commercial operation 2026-05, fully operational announcement 2026-06-18
mapping_note: 550-mi 3,000 MW HVDC Torrance Co NM -> Pinal Central AZ; terminates in Arizona, NOT at a CAISO intertie — supply-side depth behind the WECC_import node (offtakers largely CA LSEs). CAISO's 2026 Summer Assessment raises assumed net imports HE17-23 Jun-Sep by +1,009 MW 'to account for imports from SunZia's wind' — an operational stack assumption, not a rating change. Recorded-not-applied in V1 (import-tranche seam follow-up).
source_doc: Pattern press 2026-06-18; CAISO 2026 Summer Loads & Resources Assessment

instrument: CAISO 2013-14 TPP competitive award + CPUC CPCN; energized 2024-06-07
mapping_note: 125-mi 500 kV Delaney (AZ) -> Colorado River (CA, east of the West-of-River nomogram); 3,200 MW conductor capacity. Supply-side into the Path 46 area — CAISO's DELANEY500_ISL branch group carries 2026 OTC 1,425 MW with RA MIC allocation 0 (no import history yet). Post-dates the CAISO 2023 base-static vintage but is dispatch-inert (import_tranche).

project_name: North Gila - Imperial Valley No. 2 500 kV
instrument: CAISO Board approval of the 2022-2023 Transmission Plan ($340M), 2023-05-18; sponsor selected 2024-04-08
mapping_note: 82-mi 500 kV second AZ->Imperial Valley circuit parallel to Southwest Powerlink (min summer rating ~2,474 MVA; WECC path rating accepted 2019 as NGIV2). Raises AZ-to-IV delivery feeding Sunrise Powerlink and the future IV-NoSONGS line — supply-side behind the WECC_import node; no published simultaneous-transfer MW. Recorded-not-applied in V1.
source_doc: HWT WECC 2025 APR (COD Dec 2031); CAISO sponsor notice

project_name: North Coast offshore wind 500 kV package (Humboldt)
instrument: CAISO Board approval of the 2023-2024 Transmission Plan (policy projects $4.59B incl. Humboldt-Collinsville ~$2,740M + Humboldt-Fern Road $1,400M), 2024-05-23; sponsor selected 2025-05-16
mapping_note: New north-coast 500 kV paths (Humboldt -> Collinsville HVDC-as-AC ~260 mi; Humboldt -> Fern Road ~140 mi) for ~1.6 GW Humboldt offshore wind — entirely inside the NP15 zone at this topology's grain; no CAISO intertie or Path re-rate. Dispatch-inert by schema; relevant only if NP15 is ever split.
source_doc: CAISO 2023-24 plan decision presentation (CODs: Fern Road 2026, Collinsville sub 2028, Humboldt lines 2035)

instrument: BLM ROW/Notice to Proceed; FERC-accepted open-solicitation allocation (2022); CAISO Board approval as Subscriber Participating Transmission Owner (2022-12/2023-08); construction start 2023
mapping_note: 405-mi 3,000 MW 525 kV DC eastern WY -> Desert Mountain (UT) + 278-mi 1,500 MW 500 kV AC UT -> Crystal (NV); delivers WY wind to the DSW hubs inside the extended CAISO BAA via the subscriber-PTO framework. Supply-side depth behind the WECC_import node, not a CAISO intertie re-rate; MIC-relevant only at COD. Recorded-not-applied in V1.

project_name: Serrano - Del Amo - Mesa 500 kV reinforcement (CANCELLED)
instrument: CAISO Board approval of the 2022-2023 Transmission Plan ($1,125M), 2023-05-18
mapping_note: Planned new 500 kV source at Del Amo inside the LA Basin pocket (SP15_rest->LA_BASIN LCT boundary). CANCELLED by the 2025-26 plan — kept as a superseded audit row so no prior intake re-seeds an LA-Basin uplift from it.
